intro: ## Submit Your Data to Stream Selfie
aside:
![citizen science volunteers taking a stream selfie](/-static/img/forms/stream_selfie.jpg)

*IWLA*

![logo for the Izaak Walton League](/-static/img/forms/logo_iwla_266.jpg)

[Stream Selfie](/stream-selfie) is presented by [The Izaak Walton League](http://www.iwla.org/), a national nonprofit conservation group working to involve more Americans in conservation and outdoor recreation.

Example stream selfies. Select a photo to enlarge it.

kind.text: By signing up or signing in and submitting this form, you assert that you have a right to share this or these photos and that The Izaak Walton League and SciStarter have the right to use them. You also agree to receive clean water emails from The Izaak Walton League of America, and you agree to SciStarter's Terms of Use.

Upload a photo of the stream and landscape with or without YOU in it!

Please remember this photo will be marked on a map by the location of the stream and can be viewed by the public.

map.intro: [Stream Selfie](/stream-selfie) is a citizen science water project designed to identify potential water monitoring sites for volunteers to adopt. It is also designed to create an inventory of volunteer monitoring sites across the United States.
